reference_kind: Fresh independently operated live WebGL viewer. Actual Power first-type checkbox selected; Child and Normal unchecked; Neutral alignment.

browser_verification.controls: Actual mouse: Power first-type checkbox selected; Neutral alignment plus Hero/Dark control proofs; RunPower, SwimFly, age; actual orbit drags plus R reset

angle_note: R reset and actual orbit mouse drags: side+100 visually faces right, approximately square rear+180, opposite-side-100, above dy+75, below dy-65. Actual originals inspected; camera degrees are not calibrated.
opposite_influence_note: The actual viewer keeps Power first type selected when the later Run/Power control crosses through balance to full Run. All nine signed endpoints render. This observation does not establish mod policy automatically.
intermediate_blending_limitation: All nine requested later directions share the golden-orange fresh appearance at viewer age0. At25/50/75%age, silhouettes and pigments change gradually toward their mature targets. Fixed-mature single-axis25/50/75%training visibly changes shapes and colors; compatible pairs are already nearly at their paired appearance around50%on each track, while their independently requested control endpoints remain at full range. These observations do not identify exact morph formulas or a mapping from viewer age/track fractions to mod levels or lifetime. Linear age and bilinear training interpolation remain authored approximations.
shape_reference_findings: Power-first topology is an axial central crown, a separate axial rear point and two side horns; it differs from the earlier Run-first paired lateral rear prongs.
Balanced grows an up/back crown and lower rear point; opposite Run develops upper/lower axial back/down hooks while first Power stays selected.
FullPower thickens three upward/back crown points and shortens the axial rear point; Fly has a taller thinner central crest bent up/forward, very thin raised side horns and a long rear point.
Swim flattens the central crown backward and rotates side horns horizontally; RunSwim has particularly tiny lateral horns. Pair endpoints moderate their two influences.
Wings remain compact even forFly; body has large fists and feet, a central belly/back region and compact diamond/spade tail.

Natural pigments progress from fresh gold/orange/yellow toward orange/salmon balance, orange/gold Run, scarlet Power and pink/magenta-accented Fly/Swim; source tips and toes use jagged cap/rim accents, not Run forehead stripes.
Preserving Minecraft original cube, pixel face and anchors requires simplified separate cuboids rather than copying source head stretching, sculpted contours or jagged bands literally.
